summary: Frontend-only local worker acceptance checks executed against http://127.0.0.1:8787. Header close behavior (desktop + mobile), catch-all rendering, local SEO/routing contracts, and lightweight performance probes passed. Compare-to-contact full click path was partially blocked by repeated Playwright interaction-state failures after first product selection, so that exact UI chain remains a retest gap in this run.

integration_issues.flow: Compare UI full chain (select two -> compare -> pricing link -> contact)
integration_issues.issue: After first compare selection, subsequent scripted selection repeatedly failed due dropdown/query state transition; full click-path verification could not be fully completed in this run (loop-prevention applied after repeated attempts).

integration_issues.flow: Analytics transport observation during route checks
integration_issues.issue: Browser logs still showed aborted /api/track requests (net::ERR_ABORTED) while running navigation checks.

action_items: Re-run one clean manual/Playwright compare flow that re-enters search after first selection and confirms exact query carry-over via Request Project Pricing.
Investigate recurring /api/track net::ERR_ABORTED during navigation transitions.
No production/GSC claims: keep these checks scoped as local worker acceptance only.
critical_code_review_comments: Route-change close guard is present in SiteHeader via pathname effect and worked in both desktop and mobile checks.
Comparison pricing link composes carry-over from selected codes using encoded join in component source.
Contact page parses products query, caps to 3, and renders RFQ context + required inputs in SSR HTML.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Local checks performed only on http://127.0.0.1:8787. Verified: /our-works -> 301 /projects, /products/hjdba -> 410, robots.txt + sitemap.xml 200, representative catch-all routes render next-server-rendered-parity-page with metadata + JSON-LD, and header menus close after pathname changes on desktop/mobile. Compare flow probing found options and first selection works, but repeated Playwright attempts failed on second option due post-selection state transitions; stop condition applied. Continue from compare selection sequencing and confirm full request-pricing carry-over in one uninterrupted run.
rca of the issue: RCA-1 (verification gap, not confirmed product bug): compare picker clears query after first selection, causing scripted second-click attempts against stale option selectors to fail unless the query/dropdown is re-established. RCA-2 (observability): /api/track requests still intermittently abort during route transitions in browser logs, reducing confidence in analytics transport stability under rapid navigation.
